propositions: event_append.py at 794 LOC is 6 lines below the 800-LOC hard cap and approaching the breaking point
Four independent concerns—pre-lock validation, bounded git verbs, commit-failure recovery, and locked write orchestration—are intermingled in event_append.py
Extracting pre-lock event preparation (~140 LOC) and bounded git verbs (~220 LOC) into new leaf modules reduces event_append.py to ~500 LOC and creates 276 LOC of headroom under cap

Monkeypatch seams (test_own_vanished_object_is_regenerated's single setattr reaching both _git_add callers) and self-heal coupling require keeping commit-failure recovery and orchestration together in event_append.py
All bindings must remain accessible through the event_append namespace via re-exports, including alias-only references like conftest.py's _ea.canonical_bytes, with zero test file edits
